name: Samba Gliders
description: Samba Gliders is a suspended coaster in the Rio zone that opened on 12 February 2022. It stands about 25 m (82 ft) high with a track about 500 m long, and riders swing beneath the rails. Min 95cm, or 95 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Acorn Adventure
description: Acorn Adventure is a mine-train style coaster in the Ice Age zone that opened on 30 April 2022. It is about 25 m (82 ft) high with roughly 700 m of track. Min 122cm.

name: Rivet Town Roller
description: Rivet Town Roller is a spinning coaster from Chance Rides in the Robots Rivet Town zone, opened in 2022. Min 122cm.

name: Independence Day: Defiance
description: Independence Day: Defiance is a flying-theatre style ride in the Central Park zone, opened in 2022 and based on the Independence Day films. Min 100cm, or 100 to 140cm with a companion.

name: Invasion of the Planet of the Apes
description: Invasion of the Planet of the Apes is a 3D trackless dark ride in the Liberty Lane zone, where the vehicles move freely through the show scenes. Min 110cm, or 110 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Terraform Tower Challenge
description: Terraform Tower Challenge is an S&S drop tower in the Andromeda Base zone, opened in 2022. Min 122cm.

name: Alpha Fighter Pilots
description: Alpha Fighter Pilots is a Zamperla Air Race ride in the Andromeda Base zone, opened in 2022, where riders swing and spin in small fighter planes. Min 122cm.

name: ESD Global Defender
description: ESD Global Defender is an Aerobat flight ride in the Central Park zone, opened in 2022. Min 130cm.

name: Epic Voyage to Moonhaven
description: Epic Voyage to Moonhaven is an indoor boat ride in the Epic zone, opened in 2022, with a drop and a few splashes. Min 90cm, or 90 to 140cm with a companion.

name: Ice Age: Expedition Thin Ice
description: Ice Age: Expedition Thin Ice is a trackless dark ride in the Ice Age zone, opened in 2022. Min 110cm, or 110 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Sid's Rock 'N' Slide
description: Sid's Rock 'N' Slide is a spinning log ride from Zierer in the Ice Age zone, opened in 2022. Min 100cm, or 100 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Rio Carnaval Chaos!
description: Rio Carnaval Chaos! is a spinning teacups ride from Zamperla in the Rio zone, opened in 2022. Min 90cm, or 90 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Blue Sky Carousel
description: Blue Sky Carousel is a double-decker carousel in the Rio zone, opened in 2022. Min 80cm, or 80 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Bigweld's Zeppelins
description: Bigweld's Zeppelins is an aerial family ride in the Robots Rivet Town zone, opened in 2022. Min 80cm, or 80 to 122cm with a companion.

name: Epic Hummingbird Flyers
description: Epic Hummingbird Flyers is a Zierer flying-gondola ride in the Epic zone, opened in 2022. Min 95cm, or 95 to 122cm with a companion.
